title: Kate Bateman
html_source:
Kate Josephine Bateman (Mrs. Crowe) (October 7, 1842 – April 8, 1917) was an American actress. She was born at Baltimore, Maryland.
Bateman’s “greatest dramatic triumph” as an actress, was her role in Leah the Forsaken, as the title character Leah. The play opened at Niblo’s Garden in New York on January 19, 1863; it was extremely popular despite horrible reviews from dramatic critics. Bateman became identified with role of Leah, her emotional performance and “the bloodcurdling curse she hurled at her faithless Christian lover”.
